title: Bedrock Feature to java
description: Bring Bedrock mechanics to Java: no attack cooldown, auto-shield when sneaking, random strongholds, and villagers never overcharge you.
body:
# Bedrock Feature to Java

Bring some of the most beloved (or simply different) Bedrock Edition mechanics into **Minecraft Java 1.21.1+**.

---

## ✅ Currently Implemented

| Feature | Description |
|---------|-------------|
| **No attack cooldown** | Spam-click as fast as you like – every hit deals full damage. |
| **Villagers never raise prices** | Hit a villager? No grudges. Trading prices stay unchanged. |
| **Random strongholds** | Strongholds spawn randomly (~30% chance per eligible chunk) – no more fixed rings. |
| **Auto‑shield when sneaking** | Hold shift and your shield automatically raises. No flickering, works smoothly. |

---

## ⚙️ Configuration

- Fully configurable via **[Mod Menu](https://modrinth.com/mod/modmenu)** (optional but recommended).
- Each feature can be toggled on/off independently.
- Config file: `.minecraft/config/bedrockfeaturetojava.json`

---

## ❌ Planned but not yet available

- Axe damage = sword damage - 1 & axe cannot break shields (mapping issues).
- 80% accuracy for skeletons and pillagers.
- Piston‑movable containers → use **Movable Block Entities** mod as a companion.
- Lever not breaking when pushed by piston (difficult in Java).

---

## 🎯 Why this mod?

If you're a Java player who misses specific Bedrock behaviors – like no cooldown spam, forgiving villagers, or random strongholds – this mod is for you. Lightweight, client/server friendly, and respectful of your configuration choices.

---

## 🚀 Future updates

More Bedrock parity features will be added over time. Requests and bug reports are welcome.

**Enjoy your Bedrock‑flavored Java experience!** 🧱☕
